name: Bring your own phone - new line on Value 2.0
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-25. Customer voice: straightforward, polite.
scripted_messages: Hi. I have an unlocked Samsung Galaxy S24 and want to bring it to AT&T on Value 2.0 with one new line. What would my monthly total be, and what do I need to do to activate it?
Thanks. Is there an activation fee when I bring my own phone?
And does the AutoPay discount apply to this line?
Great, that's what I needed. You were friendly and clear, thank you.
No, that's all. Have a good day, bye!
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the previous question
before message 6: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 7: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
